name: globe-host
description: The /globe/ Worker (named ortho-globe on Cloudflare). It serves only: every app with package.json servedAt "/globe/" (globe-map = the front page, hex, arcs, …) is built and gathered into dist/site/globe by packages/globe/scripts/lib/gather-apps.mjs, so the Worker serves them at the same URLs.

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run verify:prod && npm run deploy:built
